title: Divide Array Into Increasing Sequences
description: Determine if an array can be divided into k or more non-decreasing subsequences of length at least k.
pseudocode:
1. freq = calculateFrequency(nums)
2. maxFreq = max(freq.values())
3. return maxFreq * k <= nums.length

steps.note: Identify max frequency, which is 3 (for the number 3)
Check if maxFreq * k <= length (3 * 2 <= 6). True, it is possible.
